Which of the following abilities ignores the other Pokemon's stat stages during damage and accuracy calculation? \ch[192,0, Unaware, Infiltrator, Darkest Lariat, Oblivious]
Which of the following abilities ignores the other Pokemon's stat stages during damage and accuracy calculation? \ch[192,0, Unaware, Infiltrator, Darkest Lariat, Oblivious]
When a Pokemon with this ability uses a damaging move or is targeted by a damaging move, the other Pokemon's stat stages are ignored during damage and accuracy calculation. Thus, when attacking, the enemy's Evasion, Defense and Sp.Def stats are ignored during damage calculation. Conversely, when a Pokemon with this ability is targeted, the Accuracy stat stages, Attack and Special Attack stat stages of the <i>attacking</i> Pokemon are ignored during damage calculation.
